lines.text: 你永远无法真正理解一个人——除非你钻进他的皮肤里走上一圈。
lines.en: You never really understand a person until you consider things from his point of view... until you climb into his skin and walk around in it.
lines.note: 阿迪克斯对斯库特的教诲：杀死一只知更鸟把同理心写成法治入门。通行定译。

lines.text: 世上唯一不服从多数表决的东西，是一个人的良心。
lines.en: The one thing that doesn't abide by majority rule is a person's conscience.
lines.note: 给斯库特讲良心的名句；IMDb quotes 可查。

lines.text: 真正的勇气是：明知一开始就输定了，还是照样开始，并且坚持到底。
lines.en: Real courage is when you know you're licked before you begin, but you begin anyway and you see it through no matter what.
lines.note: 为杜博斯太太的坚忍作注；IMDb quotes 可查。

lines.text: 斯库特，大多数人都是这样的——等你真正了解他们的时候。
lines.en: Most people are, Scout, when you finally see them.
lines.note: 结尾回应「他其实人很好」；IMDb quotes 可查。
